chunks.text_for_embedding:
Framework: RBI KYC
Jurisdiction: India
Control Domain: KYC Governance
Regulation: Chapter II, Paragraph 4
Requirement: Maintain a KYC policy duly approved by the Board of Directors or an authorized Board committee.
Evidence Expected: Board-approved KYC policy; Policy approval record; KYC governance document
Assessment Questions: Is the KYC policy formally approved by the Board or authorized committee?

Assessment Questions: Does the KYC policy contain all four required key elements?

Framework: RBI KYC
Jurisdiction: India
Control Domain: ML/TF Risk Assessment
Regulation: Chapter II, Paragraph 5A
Requirement: Periodically identify, assess and mitigate money laundering and terrorist financing risks across customers, countries/geographies, products, services, transactions and delivery channels.
Evidence Expected: ML/TF risk assessment; Risk register; Risk mitigation plan; Board review record
Assessment Questions: Is a documented ML/TF risk assessment performed periodically? Does it cover relevant customer, geographic, product, transaction and channel risks?
